headline: 25753 ACTIVE locations carry no published overall rating. A 300-row random sample fetched live from the CQC API found ZERO with a currently published rating, so no ingestion omission was detected; the population splits roughly 68% never-rated / 32% historic-rating-only. A full-population internal check agrees: zero of the 25753 have a most-recent ledger destination holding a real rating.

unrated.sql: SELECT id FROM care_providers WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (overall_rating IS NULL OR btrim(overall_rating) = '')   -- COUNT(*) = 25753

null_vs_empty_breakdown.note: The DB stores the EMPTY STRING (not NULL) for an absent rating; the predicate therefore covers btrim(...) = ''. Both are matched by the SQL above.

unrated.method: Uniform random sample of the unrated ACTIVE population drawn in SQL with ORDER BY random() LIMIT 300 (single unseeded draw, ids recorded). Each sampled location's live CQC API detail (GET {DEFAULT_BASE_URL}/locations/{id}) was classified from source evidence only: (a) currentRatings.overall.rating present -> confirmed ingestion omission; (b) no currentRatings.overall but historicRatings carries an overall -> legitimate 'no currently published rating'; (c) neither -> legitimate unrated / not applicable. Population estimates and 95% Wilson score intervals are SAMPLE-BASED ESTIMATES (n=300), NOT measured totals.
unrated.sample_query: SELECT id FROM care_providers WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (overall_rating IS NULL OR btrim(overall_rating) = '') ORDER BY random() LIMIT 300

ledger_full_population_cross_check.question: does any independent internal record contradict the blank overall_rating?
ledger_full_population_cross_check.predicate_used: trusted_event_ledger.new_value::text = 'null'  (new_value is jsonb; NEVER use IS NULL)
ledger_full_population_cross_check.why: new_value/old_value are jsonb columns; a JSON null is the text 'null', not SQL NULL. Measured: new_value IS NULL -> 4 rows (all event_type='integration_connectivity'); new_value::text='null' -> 80306 rows.
ledger_full_population_cross_check.finding: For ALL 25753 unrated ACTIVE rows the most recent rating_changed event has an absent destination ('null'), or no rating_changed event exists at all. ZERO unrated ACTIVE rows have a most-recent ledger destination holding a real rating value. This is a FULL-POPULATION, measured check (not a sample) and it finds no internal evidence of a lost rating.
ledger_full_population_cross_check.query:
with ev as (
  select e.location_id as id, e.new_value::text as dest,
         row_number() over (partition by e.location_id order by e.observed_at desc nulls last, e.id desc) rn
    from trusted_event_ledger e
    join care_providers p on p.id = e.location_id
   where e.event_type = 'rating_changed' and p.status='ACTIVE'
     and (p.overall_rating IS NULL OR btrim(p.overall_rating) = ''))
select count(*) filter (where rn=1 and dest='null'), count(*) filter (where rn=1 and dest<>'null'),
       count(*) filter (where rn=1) from ev where rn=1

provenance.question: how many unrated ACTIVE rows were last written by a reconciliation vs a signal sweep
provenance.method: care_providers has no per-row run_id. Both the reconciliation detail pass and the signal sweep call upsert_provider(), which stamps updated_at = now(). pipeline_runs records each run's started_at/completed_at, so each unrated row's updated_at was mapped into signal_poll run windows or reconciliation_batches windows.
unavailable_evidence: care_providers has no per-row source/run column (no run_id; the live table has no source_snapshot_id / source_checked_at / source_url column), so exact last-writer attribution is INFERENTIAL.

notes: CQC sentinel strings are NOT in the unrated set - they are stored verbatim in overall_rating ('Inspected but not rated' 5,640, 'No published rating' 1,644, 'Insufficient evidence to rate' 23). incremental_update.clean_location sets overall_rating = '' only when currentRatings.overall.rating is absent.

13 of 300 sample members returned a currentRatings object that carries reportDate/serviceRatings but NO 'overall' key; those are legitimately unrated, not omissions (e.g. owner examples 1-4650627138 and 1-545581747).
0 of 300 sample members returned a published overall rating at fetch time -> no ingestion omission evidenced.

ACTIVE unrated type split: Social Care Org 13,585; Primary Dental Care 5,513; Independent Healthcare Org 3,652; Primary Medical Services 1,713; NHS Healthcare Organisation 1,062; Independent Ambulance 228.
17,437 of the unrated ACTIVE rows have a last_inspection_date; 8,316 do not.
All figures produced by read-only SELECTs plus CQC public API GETs.
